title: Red team vs blue team vs purple team: which job is yours?
description: Red teams attack with permission, blue teams defend, and purple means both sides share what they learn. Here's what each cyber career involves.

scenes.say: Some people get paid to hack companies, with permission. Others get paid to stop them.
The red team plays the attacker. It's authorised to imitate a real adversary, to show which defences actually hold up.
The blue team defends. They watch the systems, spot attacks, and respond. Job titles you'll see include penetration tester on the red side, and security operations analyst on the blue.
Purple isn't always a separate team. It's red and blue working together. Red shares how it got in, blue tunes its detection, and they test again.

steps: Practise only in legal labs and CTFs
Pick a colour: attack or defend
scenes.say: Want in? Learn networking and Linux, practise only on labs and games you're allowed to use, and write up what you learn. Follow, and pick your colour.
